purpose: Verified 8-record batch 125 from the 179-record difficult reference-dependent tail. Four later-3.5 summon spells are locked across their Planar Handbook and Spell Compendium printings after pairwise source review. External Monster Manual stat blocks remain named references, and printing-specific text differences are preserved rather than normalized.

spells/summon-babau-demon-2165.name: Summon Babau Demon
spells/summon-babau-demon-2165.effectSummary: Summons one babau demon from the Infinite Layers of the Abyss. It appears where designated and acts immediately on your turn, understands your speech regardless of language, and follows your commands to the best of its ability. You must concentrate to maintain the spell, but commanding the demon is a free action. The summoned creature cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature and cannot use teleportation or planar-travel abilities. Casting time is 1 full round; range is Close; duration is concentration, up to 1 round per caster level, plus 1 round; saving throw none; spell resistance no.
spells/summon-babau-demon-2165.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. This Planar Handbook printing was cross-checked against its Spell Compendium reprint. The external babau demon stat block is intentionally preserved as a Monster Manual reference rather than expanded from memory.

provenance.role: primary Planar Handbook catalog record and digest source
